statement: An organization required to file a Form 990-series annual return or notice that fails to file for three consecutive years automatically loses its federal tax-exempt status under section 6033(j), effective as of the original filing due date of the third year's return or notice; the IRS cannot reverse a proper automatic revocation, and status is regained only through a new application for reinstatement.
caveat: Which Form 990-series return or notice applies depends on gross receipts and assets, and some organizations (churches among them) are not required to file at all. The IRS reinstatement page lists the reinstatement paths. Check the current filing thresholds before relying on a particular form.
